classes_taught.raw_text: This course provides an introduction to modern genetics. We will cover classical Mendelian laws before transitioning into advanced molecular biology, including DNA replication and the revolutionary CRISPR-Cas9 gene editing technology. Students are expected to complete lab work on fruit fly inheritance patterns.
